title: Air Force Academy religious training

tellings.quote: I was appalled a couple of years ago to hear how the Air Force Academy uh in Colorado was training, you know, their people in in religious studies, right?

plain: The US Air Force Academy in Colorado was training its people in religious studies, according to the researcher and author Peter Levenda. He tells it as something he heard a couple of years ago, without naming a source, and says he was "appalled" by it, raising it as a sign that belief and the military are more tangled than people think.
